title: U.S.-Japan Alliance Conference: The U.S.-Japan Alliance Today and Beyond
summary_en: To better understand the state of the U.S.-Japan alliance, RAND convened a conference at the JAPAN HOUSE Los Angeles in February 2026. These proceedings contain a conference overview and a short assessment of the main themes raised by participants.
title_cn: U.S.-Japan Alliance Conference: The U.S.-Japan Alliance Today and Beyond
